title: [Lean] Derive aligned ADD execution and finite-trace bit budgets
body:
## Summary

Four unchanged independently kernel-checked modules publish the explicit reference family layout, read/halve/add/write execution, aligned integer/exponent implementation and finite-trace numerator/exponent budgets. Thirty accepted probes and three printed types are source-bound in the public acceptance summary. Four new sources total 42,243 bytes; twelve immutable public/import-derived prerequisites are reused, giving 16 research modules / 128,926 bytes.

## Author-checked context

κ = 836330098538459/500000000000000000 = 0.001672660197076918. Both authors checked this contextual value and the scope. The package does not change κ or prove the selected-κ multiplication theorem.

## Coverage and limits

Finite/source-bound: raw row 2 ADD(L119,L169,1/2) and its explicit reference family layout. Parameterized: actual prefix execution and aligned Cells, plus finite-footprint bounds for arbitrary SCALE/ADD reference traces with explicit initial memory/accumulator bounds. Full-theorem coverage remains open: physical selected allocation/executor, initialization, chart transport, scratch restoration, global precision and uniform bit-cost recurrence. Hosting refinement retains actual owner and common-chart premises; frame zero alone does not discharge them.

## Reuse and acceptance

Reuse exact PR1802/1807/1985/2025 sources and credited public LemmaG/LemmaA/PrefixNorm bodies. James Chang with OpenAI assistance, Apache-2.0; original attribution is preserved. See the immutable source manifest and prepared-runtime reproduction recipe. Historical preparation labels remain unchanged; exact accepted hashes establish the later kernel status. No compilation was repeated for publication.

## Exact adoption

Publication parent: c676548106012571fefa1dce0ec16f1bcfe11dce. The five selected-result, assembly, selected-source and emitter blobs match the previously checked context exactly; contextual kappa is unchanged. No accepted proof was rerun for this adoption.

Submission continuity readback: upstream main 0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2 retains all five critical selected-source blobs and contains no Lean/toolchain/dependency-manifest changes relative to the publication parent. Other upstream CI and audit changes are not adopted into this source-only chunk.
